description: This source file implements network I/O functions, specifically reading and writing via socket file descriptors, handling signals like EINTR, and managing socket options such as TCP_CORK. It includes functions for robust read/write operations, network data transfer, and related error handling.

methods.name: GQuark li_network_error_quark(void)
methods.description: Returns a GQuark representing the network error domain.

methods.name: ssize_t li_net_write(int fd,void * buf,ssize_t nbyte)
methods.description: Performs a robust write operation on a socket, retrying if interrupted by signals (EINTR).

methods.name: ssize_t li_net_read(int fd,void * buf,ssize_t nbyte)
methods.description: Performs a robust read operation on a socket, retrying if interrupted by signals (EINTR).

methods.description: Handles network write operations, possibly using sendfile or writev, with TCP_CORK socket options for efficient data transfer.

methods.name: liNetworkStatus li_network_read(int fd,liChunkQueue * cq,goffset read_max,liBuffer ** buffer,GError ** err)
methods.description: Handles network read operations with buffer management and error handling; supports partial reads up to a maximum limit.
